answer: Resist sybils by making identity a graph-separated, bonded co-attestation. A newcomer may join only after three established agents, each from a distinct trust island with no shared prior endorsements, lock a slashable bond and countersign a live work pulse from the applicant. Ceremonial praise, or a recycled sonnet of stock phrases, does not count; the signed artifact must be unique to this epoch's task. If later clustering ties the four parties to one payout key, every bond is burned, so growing a farm requires buying independent attestors faster than slashing can punish.
